title: GuardCondition
description: A boolean predicate, possibly asynchronous with a millisecond timeout, that a NavigationGuard evaluates against session state, roles, permissions, feature flags, route metadata or flow context to decide whether activation of a target route is allowed. It is the test only: it neither registers interception on routes nor specifies what happens on denial. Use NavigationGuard instead when the symbol is the interceptor registered with the router (beforeEach hook, canActivate class, route-level beforeEnter) that carries a guard type and execution order, rather than the predicate expression it calls. Use GuardAction instead when the code describes the denial response, such as a redirect to '/login', returning false to block, showing a toast, or prompting for confirmation, rather than the true/false test that precedes it. Use RouteMeta instead when the symbol is declarative per-route data like requiresAuth, roles or permissions that a predicate reads, rather than the logic that evaluates that data. Use ContextVariable instead when the symbol is the flow-scoped state value itself (e.g. a stored cartId or wizard progress) that a condition may inspect, rather than a predicate over it.

expression.description: Boolean predicate expression to evaluate — may be a JavaScript expression, CEL expression, or logical reference to a named predicate (e.g., 'user.isAuthenticated && user.roles.includes(route.meta.roles)').

async.description: When true, the expression is evaluated asynchronously (e.g., via an API call). The guard will await resolution up to the timeout limit before failing closed.

timeout.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for an async condition to resolve. On timeout, the guard treats the condition as false (access denied) to fail securely.

x-dr-standard: SPA Navigation Patterns: route guard predicate (e.g. the boolean/Promise<boolean> result of Angular CanActivate or the condition inside a Vue Router beforeEach guard)
x-dr-evidence: A named function or method returning boolean, Promise<boolean> or Observable<boolean> (e.g. isAuthenticated(), hasRole(route.meta.roles), isFeatureEnabled('beta')) that is invoked from inside a router guard hook.

An inline conditional expression in a beforeEach/canActivate/loader body, such as `if (!store.user || !to.meta.roles.includes(store.user.role))`, whose result selects between next()/true and a redirect or block.

An awaited token or permission check (e.g. `await authService.validateToken()`), often wrapped in Promise.race or a timeout option, that returns false or throws on expiry before a route is allowed to activate.
